events.description:
Doors: 6:30PM. Showtime: 7:30PM.
Keegan Isaac & The Itsy Bitsy Big Band : Yuletide Swing with Sonia Reid

Keegan Isaac & the Itsy Bitsy Big Band return to the Broadway Theatre with Yuletide Swing , a brand new Holiday Show featuring your favourite holiday selections performed by a powerhouse 12-piece ensemble, a 1940’s-style vocal trio, all led by the Sinatra-esque vocal stylings of Keegan Isaac. The Itsy BItsy Big Band will also be joined by Saskatoon vocalist Sonia Reid , who will be lending her soulful voice to several featured performances throughout the evening.

The program will feature original music, reimagined carols, and familiar arrangements recorded by the likes of Michael Bublé, Sharon Jones & The Dap Kings, Nat “King” Cole, and Elvis Presley. This concert promises to be an unforgettable night of music and laughter that will transport you back to the Golden Age of Entertainment!

events.description:
Doors: 6:30PM. Showtime: 7:30pm
Holiday Lights: A Celebration of the Season
Celebrate the season with the Saskatoon Jazz Orchestra in a holiday tradition built on joy and community. Holiday Lights brings together beloved holiday classics, festive seasonal favourites and fresh jazz arrangements written for big band.
This year we’re joined by two outstanding vocalists from Saskatchewan’s music community. Danny Fong spent ten years as a world-touring member of the acclaimed jazz vocal group Accent before coming home to Saskatoon, and Kate Nachilobe returns to the SJO stage for the first time since 2021.
Whether you’re continuing a cherished holiday tradition or hearing the SJO for the first time, join us for an evening of music and seasonal cheer for audiences of all ages.

THE TARTAN TEA
Prairie Proud Highland Dancers' 3rd Annual Holiday Recital
Join us for a festive celebration of highland dance!
The Prairie Proud Highland Dancers invite you to our 3rd Annual Holiday Recital, The Tartan Tea! Enjoy an afternoon of spirited performances featuring a beautiful blend of traditional and contemporary Highland dancing, set to classic Celtic tunes and some of your favourite holiday songs.
Celebrate the talent, hard work, and dedication of our dancers as they showcase what they've been learning during the first few months of their dance season.
Bring your family and friends, enjoy the festive atmosphere, and experience a little Scottish flair this holiday season. It's the perfect way to kick off the holidays!
We look forward to celebrating with you!

events.title: Big Band Theory 5! | Winterruption
events.description: The Big Band Theory V: Five Years of Musical Momentum celebrates the fifth anniversary of this unique annual gathering of Saskatoon's premier big band jazz ensembles. Bringing together the University of Saskatchewan Jazz Ensemble, the Saskatoon Jazz Orchestra, the Stone Frigate Big Band, and the Footnotes Big Band, this special jazz concert within the Braodway Theatres Winteruption Festival showcases the power, energy, and enduring appeal of big band jazz. From timeless swing classics to contemporary favourites, each ensemble will bring its own distinctive sound to an evening that highlights five years of musical collaboration, community, and momentum. Join us as we celebrate this milestone with an unforgettable night of outstanding musicianship, exciting performances, and the collective force of more than a hundred jazz musicians sharing one stage.

events.title: Shaun Majumder: Born Again New Canadian Tour
events.description:
DOORS: 6:30PM. SHOWTIME: 7:30PM
Shaun Majumder is an award-winning actor, comedian, writer, producer, and director whose career has spanned more than two decades across television, film, and live performance. He currently stars as “Father Khatri” in MGM+‘s acclaimed series FROM and recently appeared as “Gary” in Peacock’s The Miniature Wife, opposite Elizabeth Banks and Matthew Macfadyen. His recent work also includes portraying “Dr. Voor” in Star Trek: Strange New Worlds. Equally adept in comedy and drama, Shaun’s screen credits include 24, The Firm, Detroit 1-8-7, Unhitched, and Cedric the Entertainer Presents. Shaun first became a household name through his legendary seventeen-season run on CBC’s This Hour Has 22 Minutes, where his singular voice as a performer and writer earned multiple Gemini and Canadian Screen Awards, establishing him as one of Canada’s most distinctive comedic talents.

events.title: Ashley Borody As The Ultimate Tribute to ADELE
events.description:
Showtime: 7:30PM.

Parton Production’s Presents, North Americas greatest Adele tribute.
This is a powerful, soul stirring live experience that honours not just Adele’s music but the emotional depth and authenticity that made her a global icon. Fronted by the extraordinary Ashley Borody as The Ultimate Tribute to Adele this tribute captures Adele’s unmistakable vocal tone, emotional phrasing and commanding stage presence with stunning accuracy. Ashley will take you on an intimate journey through Adele’s most beloved hits, Hello, Someone Like You, Rolling in the Deep, Set Fire to the Rain and so many more delivered with raw honesty and breathtaking control.
Backed by a world class live band and elevated production the show balances arena level power with heartfelt intimacy, mirroring Adele’s own ability to make massive rooms feel deeply personal. Every detail, from musical arrangements to storytelling moments between songs is thoughtfully crafted to honour the original artist while allowing the performers own artistry to shine. This is more than just a tribute, it’s a celebration of resilience, love, heartbreak and triumph.
In short Ashley Borody’s Ultimate Tribute to Adele isn’t just the best in North America it’s a night that feels unmistakably real, unforgettable and worthy of Adele herself. Selling concerts out across North America, Ashley will leave you breathless.

performers.name: Ashley Borody As The Ultimate Tribute to ADELE

The Snowed In Comedy Tour is back with a brand new show!

Now celebrating its 18th year, what began as a wild idea in the middle of a Canadian winter has snowballed into a national phenomenon and Canada's biggest comedy tour.

This year's powerhouse lineup features Dan Quinn, Just for Laughs competition winner and tour founder; Paul Myrehaug, winner of the $25,000 Great Canadian Laugh Off; Pete Zedlacher, SiriusXM Top Comic winner and 6-time Canadian Comedy Award nominee; and Erica Sigurdson, one of CBC's The Debaters most popular performers with more than 80 appearances.

Four international comedians. One stage. Eighteen years of laughs.
Critics call it “Better than the Just for Laughs Tour” and “A Flurry of Laughs You Can't Miss.”
Don't just get through winter - laugh your way through it with the Snowed In Comedy Tour.

Strait From Me to You: A George Strait Tribute featuring Gil Grand
Showtime: 7:30PM. Doors: 6:30PM.

ABOUT GIL GRAND
Gil Grand is an eight-time Canadian Country Music Association (CCMA) nominee along with CCMA “Male Vocalist of the Year” and “Record Producer of the Year” winner. Grand dove head-first onto the country music scene in 1998 when he signed with Sony’s Monument Records. His debut album, Famous First Words, produced his first Number One single and helped him receive three CCMA nominations in 1999 including “Male Vocalist of the Year,” “Album of the Year” and “Wrangler Rising Star.”

The road that started on the pop music charts in the ‘70’s, took a winding turn into country music in the

SANDMAN
Sandman, the only Metallica sanctioned tribute band, has been blowing audiences away since 1994. Band members Rick Van Dyk (lead vocals and lead/rhythm guitar), Joe Di Taranto (lead/rhythm guitar and vocals), Paulo Fonseca (bass and vocals), Brent Niemi (drums), collectively have a lifetime of musical experience playing and recording.

events.title: RUMOURS: The Ultimate Fleetwood Mac Tribute Show
events.description:
Doors: 7PM. Showtime 7:30PM.
RUMOURS, The Ultimate Fleetwood Mac Tribute Show

VaughnCo Entertainment is proud to present “Rumours” The Ultimate Fleetwood Mac tribute show based in Los Angeles, California. The group recreates the legendary band in its youthful heyday from 1975-1979. “It’s been said imitation is the sincerest form of flattery. I say THANK YOU!”- Richard Dashut Record Producer - Fleetwood Mac albums including Rumours, Tusk, Live Mirage, Tango In The Night, and Time.

After finding huge success in Los Angeles, selling out their regular Roxy Theatre performances month after month, the band moved from the world famous Sunset Strip to Casinos, Theatres, and clubs all over Canada and the United States.

Rumours has meticulously put together a show that spares no detail. From period accurate equipment and costumes to spot on characterizations and musical performances, “Rumours" takes you back to a time when music was still an unbridled cultural experience, and bands weren't afraid to put on a show.

Relive the rock and roll magic with “Rumours” The Ultimate Fleetwood Mac Tribute Show!
